subject: general
question:
Which of the following is correct regarding the Harappan drainage system?

I. It was only for royal use

Il. It was highly advanced and well planned
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Harappan civilization was renowned for its **highly advanced and well-planned drainage system**, which reflects their engineering prowess.
 
• The drainage system was part of the public infrastructure and was not restricted to royal use. Hence, **statement I is incorrect**.
 
• Each house in the Harappan cities had an access to a drainage system that connected to larger public drains, showcasing **standardized urban planning**.
 
• The drains were often covered with bricks or stone slabs and regularly cleaned, indicating a sophisticated approach to sanitation and hygiene.
 
• Harappan drains were designed to carry wastewater out of the city, thereby preventing waterlogging and maintaining cleanliness. Hence, statement II is correct
